name: Crystal Crop Protection
summary: Delhi-based agrochemicals and hybrid seeds maker (80% crop protection, 19% seeds) with 14,700 distributors, raising ₹455 Cr (₹355 Cr fresh, ~₹101 Cr OFS) mostly to repay debt.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹3,152 Cr (+17%), EBITDA 14.5%, PAT ₹145 Cr (+22%), RoNW 7.1%, debt ₹820 Cr; Q1 FY27 operating cash flow only ₹43 Cr
quota: QIB up to 50% · NII at least 15% · Retail at least 35%
positives: Revenue +17-21% a year; EBITDA margin up from 9.4% to 14.5%
Diversified brands, 18 granted patents, top-three positions in pearl millet and mustard seed
red_flags: CBI and ED excise-refund case (₹75.5 Cr) against the company and two promoters, still pending
~24.6x P/E vs peer average 20x, with RoNW only 7.1%
Heavy working capital: Q1 FY27 operating cash flow ₹43 Cr, receivables up 34% since March
anchor: ₹135.95 Cr from 17 institutions (10 fund houses) at ₹272 on 17 Nov; names not verified
